items.title: SDE bootstrap: inventory State Programming research in HelixNote
items.description: Systematic inventory of HelixNote repository research artifacts (State Programming, Four-Tier architecture, boundary preservation, Experiments 1-3) to establish provenance for SDE migration.

items.title: Experiment 1 evidence consolidation
items.description: Consolidate HelixNote Experiment 1 (Observed-Value Boundary Amplification, MDR 66.7%, BCA 4.0) into an SDE evidence record with full provenance.

items.title: Experiment 2 evidence consolidation
items.description: Consolidate HelixNote Experiment 2 (Boundary Authority hardening, Target A-D, MDR 100%, BCA 4.0 unchanged, residual no-op finding) into an SDE evidence record with full provenance.

items.title: Corrected Experiment 3 evidence consolidation
items.description: Consolidate the corrected HelixNote Experiment 3 (commit 8ac05fd, agent-cost-comparison-v3) into an SDE evidence record, using corrected figures only (76 log entries, 2.1x ratio, incomplete Condition B telemetry, 4.0 BCA third replication).

items.title: Four-Tier doctrine consolidation
items.description: Establish doctrine/FOUR-TIER-ARCHITECTURE.md as the canonical SDE statement of the Four-Tier model, citing HelixNote's Four-Tier Conformance Audit and State-System Pilot Report.

items.title: Boundary Preservation doctrine consolidation
items.description: Establish doctrine/BOUNDARY-PRESERVATION.md, citing HelixNote's Semantic Boundary Investigation (commit a7639d8) for failure classes, three-contract model, and wire contract rule.

items.title: Research registry normalization (evidence/hypothesis/theory)
items.description: Create EV-/HY-/TH-/DF- records under research/ for migrated State Programming findings and run ./ros registry build so generated registries reflect them.

items.title: Evidence-to-engineering map
items.description: Create doctrine/EVIDENCE-TO-ENGINEERING-MAP.md mapping each SDE engineering rule to its evidence state (supported/contradicted/open) per mission working principle.

items.title: SDE glossary
items.description: Create doctrine/GLOSSARY.md defining State Programming and State-Directed Engineering terms consistently.

items.title: Construction Method v0.1
items.description: Scaffold method/CONSTRUCTION-METHOD-v0.1.md (provisional workflow: requirement through stop) from Experiment 1-3 evidence.

items.title: Change Classification
items.description: Create method/CHANGE-CLASSIFICATION.md defining Semantic/Boundary/Mechanical-Propagation/Presentation change classes and fast-path vs full-path handling.

items.title: Verification Method
items.description: Create method/VERIFICATION-METHOD.md mapping failure classes to earliest reliable detection layer (compiler/architecture/contract/persistence/behavioral/runtime/uncertainty).

items.title: Agent Execution Rules
items.description: Create method/AGENT-EXECUTION-RULES.md operationalizing the construction method for autonomous coding agents, including the mechanical-feedback-before-search rule from Experiment 3.

items.title: Engineering Metrics
items.description: Create method/ENGINEERING-METRICS.md distinguishing routine engineering metrics from research-only metrics, and self-report vs harness-telemetry evidence classes.

items.title: SDE templates
items.description: Add templates/sde/ (work-item, execution-log, completion-report, engineering-trial-report) reusing ROS template conventions.

items.title: Chronology / history
items.description: Create research/CHRONOLOGY.md recording dated State Programming and SDE bootstrap milestones from git history.

items.title: Migration audit
items.description: Independently verify provenance, Experiment 3 accuracy, no research mutation, supersession marking, doctrine confidence, ROS integrity, git integrity, chronology and traceability before declaring the bootstrap complete.

items.title: First engineering validation design (not executed)
items.description: Design (do not execute) the first SDE Construction Method validation trial on a new, non-HelixNote application.

items.title: Execute first engineering validation trial
items.description: Execute (not merely design) the first SDE Construction Method validation on a non-HelixNote project, per method/FIRST-VALIDATION-DESIGN.md. Deliberately left open by the migration bootstrap — do not begin without a dedicated scoping pass (application choice, frozen requirement, baseline).
